head: 5f92f5eb7fd194826aab2ad0844e474f13990938

finding.evidence_level: Source-confirmed compatibility risk; precise regressions ready; latest runtime unexecuted
finding.workflow: Create a native source containing a symbol inline in text, place that file linked in another document, then export SVG or AI/PDF artwork.
effects: The prepared source symbol is namespaced but TextRun.inline.symbol is not; artwork is missing if the parent lacks Dot, or resolves to the parent Dot if it exists.
Prepared resources omit child symbolSizes; even after reference scoping is fixed, natural inline aspect ratio is lost for normalized non-square symbols.
finding.cause: Existing placed_document::rename covers text paints but not new inline symbol references; add_resources copies symbol art but omits the new source natural-size metadata.
finding.baseline: Producer file unchanged since e037; inline reference and natural-size consumers arrived on upstream 5f92. This is not introduced by the local SVG metadata/editing-payload patch.
finding.editing_payload: Local SVG attachment is serialized from the original document before preparation; native/AI restore the original tree and retained source bytes. Source inspection found no extra editing-payload loss; visible output preparation has the new compatibility gap.
finding.negative_expectation: Reference test: no-collision lookup fails, or collision lookup returns the red parent art instead of blue source art. Size test: expected bounds 40x10, actual imported normalized bounds 20x20. Expected failures are not executed negatives.

merge_checks.candidate_extra_save_delta: review-latest includes the live-preview save-date stamping block absent from files-current; file encoding/body restoration unchanged by that block.

composition_note: Parent expanded review-latest to staged UI/trace/updates composition during the review. All nine recorded file/native/inline source hashes remained unchanged; this report is scoped to those paths.
